content.text:
**Analyzing the Pattern**

I've identified a vertical line of 2s in column 2 and a horizontal line of 3s in row 1, intersecting at (1, 2). That point is enclosed by an outbox (x10). Now I'm trying to figure out what x10 represents. I see some relation to another variable, x6. I'm trying to determine its definition based on color.


**Defining the Outbox**

I've clarified the definition of x10, the outbox. It's the 3x3 perimeter around point (1, 2). I've calculated the bounding box of x10 using the definitions of backdrop and intersection. Now I see that the center point (1,2) is NOT in the outbox. The filled box around (1, 2) is now yellow! I'm trying to connect all the relationships of the variables.
